title: Do not decorate artifact-repo helpers with catch_mlflow_exception
answers: artifact download returns an error response that is treated as a repository
why was the catch_mlflow_exception decorator removed from _get_artifact_repo
helper returning a Flask Response instead of an artifact repository
body:
Symptom: when building the artifact repository for a run failed, the error could come back as a Flask Response, and the calling handler then used that Response as if it were an artifact repository.
Root cause: mlflow/server/handlers.py:_get_artifact_repo was wrapped in @catch_mlflow_exception even though it is an internal helper, not a handler.
Fix pattern: Keep the decorator off internal helpers that return objects. Let the exception propagate to the decorated handler, which already converts it to a response.
Constraints: Only valid while every caller is itself a decorated handler. The name _get_artifact_repo is kept as a mocking seam: tests/server/test_handlers.py patches mlflow.server.handlers._get_artifact_repo at about ten sites, so renaming or inlining it touches those tests.
applies: Internal helpers in mlflow/server/handlers.py that return repositories or other non-response values.
says: Downloading run artifacts crashes the server instead of returning a proper error.
Clicking to view experiment run files causes an unhandled internal server error.
Failed artifact repository connections crash the backend rather than showing an error page.
Accessing missing run artifacts breaks the web application instead of reporting failure cleanly.
Handle artifact storage lookup failures gracefully without crashing downstream request handlers.
search: Internal server helpers that return objects rather than HTTP responses must not be decorated with catch_mlflow_exception to prevent returning a Flask Response where an artifact repository is expected. In mlflow/server/handlers.py:_get_artifact_repo, removing the decorator allows exceptions to propagate to calling handlers that are already decorated to handle response conversions. This rule applies to internal helpers in mlflow/server/handlers.py returning non-response objects, provided all callers remain decorated handlers. The helper function name _get_artifact_repo must be preserved as a mocking seam because tests/server/test_handlers.py patches it across approximately ten test sites.
